questions.question: Who played Jack Dawson in Titanic?
questions.note: Kate Winslet played Rose; they were later reunited in Revolutionary Road.

questions.question: Who played the title character in Forrest Gump?
questions.note: Hanks won Best Actor; the film also won Best Picture.

questions.question: Who played Clarice Starling in The Silence of the Lambs?
questions.note: Opposite Anthony Hopkins as Hannibal Lecter. Moore played Clarice in the 2001 sequel.

questions.question: Who played Neo in The Matrix?
questions.note: Laurence Fishburne played Morpheus; Carrie-Anne Moss played Trinity. Will Smith turned the role down.

questions.question: Who played Captain Jack Sparrow in the Pirates of the Caribbean films?
questions.note: The first film, The Curse of the Black Pearl, landed in 2003.

questions.question: Who played Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films?
questions.note: Daniel Radcliffe is Harry; Rupert Grint is Ron.

questions.question: Who played the Joker in The Dark Knight?
questions.note: A posthumous Best Supporting Actor Oscar.

questions.question: Who played Tony Stark / Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.note: The role that relaunched his career, starting with Iron Man in 2008.

questions.question: Who played Katniss Everdeen in The Hunger Games films?
questions.note: Woodley was Tris in Divergent; Stewart was Bella in Twilight.

questions.question: Who played James Bond in Casino Royale (2006), his first film in the role?
questions.note: Brosnan’s last Bond film was Die Another Day (2002).
